json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

msg.content: Could you help design a travel itinerary for 2 people, starting in Minneapolis and visiting 2 cities in Tennessee, spanning from March 2nd to March 6th, 2022? Our budget is set at $2,000. We will not be considering flight as a mode of transportation and would like to have non-shared rooms for accommodation. Also, we'd prefer smoking-friendly accommodations, as we are smokers.

We will not be considering flight as a mode of transportation and would like to have non-shared rooms for accommodation. Also, we'd prefer smoking-friendly accommodations, as we are smokers.

content.content:
We need to create travel itinerary for 2 people, start Minneapolis, visit 2 cities in Tennessee, dates March 2-6 2022 (5 days). No flights, so likely drive. Need non-shared rooms, smoking-friendly. Budget 2000 total. Provide plan per day, then call submit_day_plan for each day. Must include city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to pick two Tennessee cities, maybe Nashville and Memphis. Start Minneapolis, drive to Nashville (approx 10-11h). Then maybe Memphis. Return? Not required, but itinerary spans 5 days; start in Minneapolis and visiting 2 cities in TN. Likely end back in Minneapolis? Not specified. Could just end in Memphis. We'll create day 1 travel from Minneapolis to Nashville (drive). Day 2 Nashville activities. Day 3 Nashville to Memphis drive. Day 4 Memphis activities. Day5 Memphis to Minneapolis drive back.

Need to keep within $2000 for 2 people. Estimate: car rental (or using own car) fuel cost approx $200 total. Hotels: 4 nights (since travel nights). Smoking-friendly non-shared rooms maybe $120 per night average = $480. Meals: $50 per day per person = $500. Attractions: maybe $100. Total approx $1380 < $2000.

Provide specific restaurants and attractions.

Now need to call submit_day_plan for each day (1-5). Fill fields.

Day 1: city: "from Minneapolis to Nashville". current_city: "Nashville". transportation: "Drive, approx 11 hrs, distance ~800 miles". breakfast: maybe "Hell's Kitchen, Minneapolis". attraction: "-" (none). lunch: "Roadside Diner, on I-35". dinner: "The Southern Steak & Oyster, Nashville". accommodation: "Smoking-friendly room at Comfort Suites Downtown Nashville". Ensure smoking-friendly mention.

Day 2: city Nashville. transportation "-". breakfast: "Pancake Pantry, Nashville". attraction: "Country Music Hall of Fame, Nashville; Ryman Auditorium, Nashville". lunch: "Hattie B's Hot Chicken, Nashville". dinner: "Puckett's Grocery & Restaurant, Nashville". accommodation same.

Day3: travel from Nashville to Memphis. transportation: "Drive, approx 3.5 hrs, 210 miles". breakfast: "Biscuit Love, Nashville". attraction: "-" maybe "Graceland, Memphis" but that's next day. Lunch: "BBQ on the road". We'll put "Central BBQ, Memphis" arrival. dinner: "Café Eclectic, Memphis". accommodation: "Smoking-friendly room at La Quinta Inn & Suites Memphis Downtown".

Day4: Memphis attractions. breakfast: "Brother Juniper's, Memphis". attraction: "Graceland, Memphis; National Civil Rights Museum, Memphis". lunch: "Central BBQ, Memphis". dinner: "Gus's World Famous Fried Chicken, Memphis". accommodation same.

Day5: travel back to Minneapolis. transportation: "Drive, approx 11 hrs, 800 miles". breakfast: "Cafe Magnolia, Memphis". attraction: "-" . lunch: "Roadside Diner". dinner: "Home". accommodation: "-".

Now call submit_day_plan for each day.
